newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pernod in talks to buy stake in Larios.
newsitem.headline: Pernod in talks to buy stake in Larios.

text.p: Drinks group Pernod Ricard is discussing acquiring a stake in Spanish drinks firm Larios, chairman Patrick Ricard said on Wednesday.
"The discussions continue. If the deal works out, Larios would allow us to reinforce our position in Spain," he told a news conference, adding that the Spanish firm was "very strong and sound."
The group last year expanded its business in Belgium, Greece, Canada, Venezuela, India and Mexico and expects to pursue this strategy in 1997.
Ricard said the group had no plans to buy back shares for the moment. "We'd rather buy companies than our own shares, but if we find nothing to buy, we would do that," he said.

He said the company would not raise money in the markets to fund an acquisition. Its debt at the end of 1996 stood roughly unchanged at 3.3 billion francs on equity that rose to 10.8 billion from 9.6 billion.
